relationships.subject: yohimbine
relationships.evidence_quote: However, compared with the CCI + M3 + CNO + Saline group, the mechanical pain threshold and thermal nociceptive pain thresholds of the CCI + M3 + CNO + Yohimbine group significantly reduced

key_findings: Chemogenetic LC:SC activation raises pain thresholds, increases spinal NE and reduces WDR firing in CCI mice, reversed by yohimbine
LC:SC activation reduces TNF-α/IL-1β in microglia and glial activation in SDH; α2B-AR is highly expressed in microglia
